title: 2024 Egyptian-Japanese radar survey finds L-shaped structure near Great Pyramid
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2024 Egyptian-Japanese radar survey finds L-shaped structure near Great Pyramid, about 2024 at Western cemetery, Giza, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In 2024, a collaborative effort between Egyptian and Japanese researchers using ground penetrating radar and electrical resistivity tomography mapped the western cemetery adjacent to the Great Pyramid.

plain: The podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 2024 Egyptian and Japanese researchers scanned the ground of the western cemetery next to the Great Pyramid at Giza. According to Michels, they used ground-penetrating radar and electrical measurements that can map what lies underground without digging, and found an L-shaped structure beneath the surface. He tells it as a hint that there may be more hidden under Giza than people know.
